_doc: Rules for ops_watch.py (the Dispatcher's deterministic measurement arm, V3_ROLES_BUILD_EIGHT_CHAIRS_ONE_TABLE). Keys are glob patterns over point keys (family.name). Only MEASURED points feed the band, run and silent rules; a target names the marks it accepts. A target with alarm true files one rimflow item when the condition is NEW, and re-arms only after it clears.

band._doc: a point outside the baseline mean +/- k sigma. Baseline: the last baseline_days of MEASURED points, minus the last exclude_recent_h; needs min_points. Sigma is floored (max of sigma_floor_rel x |mean| and sigma_floor_abs) so a flat series does not flag on noise.

run._doc: n consecutive same-direction changes (equal neighbours collapse) in the KPI series named here; a drift the band cannot see yet.

silent._doc: a series that was MEASURED within the baseline and has not been MEASURED for its hours: the instrument went blind.

alarm._doc: Filing: spawn as RUNNER from the dispatch clone (its testq/ingest.py: rimflow + publish) under QHOME/ingest.lock, the lock the ingest and the Dispatcher take. RM_OPS_ALARM_CLONE / RM_OPS_ALARM_PARENT override.
alarm._clear_passes_doc: an open alarm clears (and re-arms) only after 4 clear readings in a row (1 h at 15 min): a reading that wobbles across its line files one item, not one per wobble. UNMEASURED readings neither clear nor reset the count (a flaky instrument must not pin an alarm open forever)

token_talk._doc: No-AI drift measure (owner 2026-10-27: only Operations analyses burn; every other role is token-blind). Per seat and role: the % of its reports in window_days (ledger notes/closes by that seat, commit messages by path owner, finished role-run result text) holding at least one term. Terms are regex fragments, whole-word, case-insensitive; a bare cap is not a term (log caps, size caps), a token/daily/week/session/usage cap is. Operations is excluded (its OPS_* ledger items and its role runs). Under min_reports reports the point is UNMEASURED, never 0.
